title: The Power of the Dark Side
subtitle: Owen Scott Muir, M.D., DFAACAP joins the "mind the force" podcast
body_html:
The power of the dark side…is quite a thing. Luckily, I was invited to join a conversation about the role of the dark side in the Star Wars universe. The Mind The Force podcast is a series of conversations about the intersection of mental health and Star Wars.

We delve into to the power, lure, and beauty of the force and its dark side together. Join us for one of my favorite podcasts appearances of all time. Mentalizing the dark side of the force? This is what we dig into. Please, leave a review on this podcast if you enjoy it. And consider sharing with your friends.
